items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...did you think of Benny Goodman, Artie Shaw. What/ those guys? [INTERVIEWEE] Good.

ctx.x: No, I never went to it. I never went to it. Not that I didn't want to, but man, we stayed out of New York so much, we got to New York and no one had a chance to hear me. I was with all them bands playing, all them different guys. Wasn't no big thrill to me. A lot of people went, but I mean, I had a lot of other things to do besides that.
Well, what did you think about -- how did you like the white bands that were around at the time, did you think of Benny Goodman, Artie Shaw. What/ those guys?
